segments.text: Such defects in obedience make no flaw in your Justification. For your Justification is not built upon your obedience, but upon Christs, Rom. 3. 24. and how incompleat and defective soever you be in your selves, yet at the same instant, you are compleat in him which is the head of all principality and power, Col. 2. 10. Wo to Abraham, Moses, David, Paul, and the most eminent Saints that ever lived, if their Justification and acceptation with God had depended upon the perfection and compleatness of their own obedience.
